EXISTING ANNEX (S1 back-span dashed, continues to +2.30 m — D7/A-501)
SCHEME S1 (as render): B2 cantilever SHS 200x200x12.5 + 2.0 m back-span (red dashed).
SCHEME S2 (alternative): add post P3 + pad F3 (red dashed square); B2 becomes RHS 200x100x6.3 simply supported. Engineer to select after survey.

Plywood deck diaphragm: 18 mm ply fixed to J1/beams with 4.8 mm self-drilling wood-to-steel screws @ 150 edges / 300 field. All steel HDG. Temporary bracing until deck fixed. Connections C1–C8: see S-101. Foundations: see S-101 foundation plan & D1/A-500.
